what: Every trial a deflated Sharpe must count, committed so the number survives a clone. out/ledger.json is gitignored and is absent from every fresh checkout; without this file crosstest.py counted 0 prior trials there and deflated against 2 instead of 39. ledger.prior_trials() reads it.
how: An entry with in_ledger true is a SNAPSHOT of backtests the ledger itself holds: the live ledger replaces it once it holds at least as many. An entry with in_ledger false was never written to the ledger and is always added on top. Append a row for every new trial that does not record itself to the ledger, citing the saved output that holds it. Never edit a row.

open_questions_for_the_owner: Do nulltest runs spend trial budget? nulltest.py records them as kind "nulltest" (nulltest.py:479, :494) and nothing counts that kind, so the nine-symbol rule sweeps currently cost nothing.
Is the count global or per symbol? crosstest.py counts every backtest; combine.py --count-ledger counts one symbol's (combine.py:146). They disagree even when the ledger is present.
Runs made with --no-record (trial 3, the E-15 replications) are in neither the ledger nor this file.
